subject: Leadership slot needed: Infrastructure deep-dive (Exec sponsor attendance)
body:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@olivetech.com>; Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@olivetech.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership slot needed: Infrastructure deep-dive (Exec sponsor attendance)

Hi Priya / Daniel —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As discussed, wed like to run a focused infrastructure/operational deep-dive for OliveTechs platform team and engineering leadership so we can:

- Walk through runtime architecture and KV/cache behavior at scale
- Surface where we can optimize for OliveTechs latency SLOs and cost targets
- Align on rollout controls and fallback policies for production

One ask from your side: can an executive sponsor (CTO/VP Eng) be available for the first 30 minutes to join for framing and any risk questions? That helps surface the right decision-makers early.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 2, 10:0011:30
- Tue Nov 2, 14:0015:30
- Wed Nov 3, 09:0010:30

Ive looped in Aditya (product/arch), Marissa (solutions), and Evelyn (customer success) from our side. Draft agenda attached (Agenda_Infra_DeepDive_v3.pdf).

If the exec sponsor cant make any of those windows, please propose a slot and well do our best to accommodate.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: Agenda_Infra_DeepDive_v3.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

-----
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@olivetech.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@olivetech.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership slot needed: Infrastructure deep-dive (Exec sponsor attendance)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the agenda and the options. We definitely want the exec sponsor present for the opening and Q&A. Quick notes from our side:

- The CTO is available Tue Nov 2 but only 11:0011:30 PST (tight window).
- VP Eng is traveling and not available that week. If the CTO cant do the full 30, wed prefer a 20-30 minute briefing at the top of the session.
- Can you confirm who from Redwood will be presenting the KV/cache and the fallback scenarios?

Tentative attendee list: Priya Shah (CTO), Daniel Ruiz (Head of Platform), procurement@olivetech.com (for later contract questions).

If Nov 2 at 11:00 PST works, well accept that and ask that the exec segment be kept to 30 minutes.

Best,
Priya
Priya Shah
CTO, OliveTech
priya.shah@olivetech.com

-----
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@olivetech.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership slot needed: Infrastructure deep-dive (Exec sponsor attendance)

Hi Priya —

11:0011:30 PST on Nov 2 is fine. We can hold the first 30 minutes for CTO remarks + directed Q&A. Aditya will lead the KV/cache and fallback walkthroughs; Marissa will handle the production rollout/SLAs and Evelyn will cover success metrics and next steps.

Im attaching a one-page Exec Join Instructions doc that summarizes what well cover in the sponsor segment and suggested prompts for the CTO (Exec_Join_Instructions.docx).

Ill send a calendar invite once weve confirmed everyone on your side.

Thanks,
Lauren

Attachment: Exec_Join_Instructions.docx (DOCX, 1 page)

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@olivetech.com>, Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@olivetech.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership slot needed: Infrastructure deep-dive (Exec sponsor attendance)

All — quick availability check from my side: Nov 2 at 11:00 PST works for me. Ill create the calendar invite and include an initial 30-minute pinned slot for the CTO, then the broader 90-minute technical session immediately after.

Calendar invite draft: https://calendar.redwood-inference.com/invite/draft/infra-deep-dive-nov2

Ill also add a short pre-read link to the invite and flag the executive segment in the agenda so the CTO knows to join for the opening.

-Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com

-----
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@olivetech.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@olivetech.com>, procurement@olivetech.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership slot needed: Infrastructure deep-dive (Exec sponsor attendance)

Lauren / Marissa —

Confirmed: Nov 2 at 11:0011:30 PST for the executive sponsor segment, followed by the technical deep-dive (11:30:30). Our CTO will join for the first 30 minutes only. Daniel will stay for the full session. Procurement will review contract milestones afterwards.

Please send the final invite + dial-in and well add it to the CTOs calendar. Wed like a 5-minute summary slide highlighting migration risks to discuss during the exec window.

Thanks,
Priya

-----
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@olivetech.com>, Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@olivetech.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>, procurement@olivetech.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership slot needed: Infrastructure deep-dive (Exec sponsor attendance) — Final invite

Priya / Daniel —

Great — confirmed Nov 2, 11:0012:30 PST (11:0011:30 PST executive sponsor segment). Calendar invite attached and live: Infra_DeepDive_CalendarInvite.ics

What were sending you now:
- Final agenda + pinned exec slides (Agenda_Infra_DeepDive_v3.pdf)
- Exec Join Instructions (Exec_Join_Instructions.docx)
- Calendar invite (Infra_DeepDive_CalendarInvite.ics)

Dial-in: https://meet.redwood-inference.com/infra-deep-dive-nov2 (passcode in calendar invite)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/olivetech/deal/DL-2026-0189

If anything changes on your side, flag it here and well adjust. Looking forward to the discussion and having the CTO for the opening.

Thanks,
Lauren

Attachment: Infra_DeepDive_CalendarInvite.ics (ICS, calendar invite)
